claims.text: Children 1 to 5 y: chronic submaxillary/submandibular cervical lymphadenitis is commonly due to MAC or M. scrofulaceum.
claims.quote: In children 1 to 5 years of age, chronic submaxillary and submandibular cervical lymphadenitis is commonly due to MAC or M. scrofulaceum.

claims.text: Excision is USU adequate tx; antibiotics (eg, macrolides) may be needed for recurrent or recalcitrant cases.
claims.quote: Usually, excision is adequate treatment, and chemotherapy may not be required; however, antibiotics (eg, macrolides) may be needed for recurrent or recalcitrant cases
